text:
**Link for AI v2 (artifact_ui.js and patch v4, attached).** In an Artifact the button now copies one self-contained text: the post (title, body, latest 20 comments), its id, the deep link, and how each kind of AI answers:

| Receiver | `#/post/<id>` deep link | The copied text |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code session (web or desktop) with ArtifactData | not needed: reads the post by id | yes: read, answer with `reply_to`, deliver into `kit_artifacts` |
| Claude in Chrome (owner's browser) | not guaranteed: the page runs in claude.ai's frame; unverified that the fragment reaches it | yes: open the board, Ctrl/Cmd+K, type the id, comment starting with `[chrome]` |
| A chat with no board access | no | yes: it answers from the post in the text; the owner pastes the answer back |

Offline check (Chromium, stub `window.claude`): opening the page with `#/post/P-a` opens the post; the copied text holds body, comments and the Chrome steps; no page error.
